description: A free mobile-delivered mathematics revision service developed by Nokia and partners for Grade 10 learners in South African public schools.

description: A researcher-developed 20-item multiple-choice achievement test for measuring undergraduate students' acquisition of organic-compound nomenclature and concepts.

description: A place-based Promise Neighborhood initiative serving a defined area of North Minneapolis through coordinated early-childhood, education, and family-support services.
